title: Machine Learning-Driven Design of Experiments for CO<sub>2</sub> Mineralization of Steel Slag Materials.
summary: An ANN analyzed literature-derived steel-slag carbonation experiments and virtual factorial effects to identify process-specific controls and interactions. These are model-derived interpretations of existing experiments, not new experimental confirmation or causal proof.
ai_technology: Artificial neural network with virtual factorial-effect analysis
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: Literature-compiled steel-slag data were analyzed for carbonation response; virtual factorial effects assessed process-variable interactions.
evidence.unknown: Grouped validation remains pending; model-derived interactions are not independent experimental or causal confirmation.
